newsitem.title: UK: Travel can be murder on the Orient Express.
newsitem.headline: Travel can be murder on the Orient Express.

text.p: Travel could be murder on the Orient Express in 1997.
The famous train is to stage murder mystery trips that echo the whodunnit by crime writer Agatha Christie.
The first killer journey is planned from London to the south coast resort of Brighton on March 14. Actors will provide clues to the murder which passengers will then try to solve.

"We found that plenty of our customers were Agatha Christie fans and knew all about the film of her book "Murder on the Orient Express', so we decided to give the trips a go," said a spokeswoman for the company.
